rejected_titles: Unused locals r,g,h (claimed blocker - compiler-legal; 153 tests green)
Grace-row count omitted when zero (hash-only sink; no reader exists)
prev_in_surge unsaved mid-surge restore (no byte-restore path; snapshot is memcpy; replay rebuilds)
Rolling-window u64 underflow (exact mod-2^64 algebra; correct)
Surge-win path has no replay test (verify_replay runs in-run for health_win.dem; 20/20 green)
Frozen identical hashes 'verify nothing' (the freeze IS the E17 barrier proof)
23000ms capture inside frozen tail (the frozen frame IS the terminal frame)
75.5s capture gap (T1 covers every tick; T2 set satisfies the spec)
Elided golden body unverifiable (Perkins's chunking; verified against the full worktree manifest)
health_lose digest '~460' (Perkins digest nit; manifest header is authoritative at 480)

warnings.title: Meter card backdrop paints over the HUD title every frame (health-on session)
warnings.det: draw_hud draws the title (x12..~705, y10..32, size 22) BEFORE draw_health_meter; the card backdrop (x 410..870, y 0..52, alpha 240) then washes out the title's right half every frame the meter is live. No golden covers the app HUD.
warnings.fix: Move the meter card below the title (or shrink the title/backdrop); draw the backdrop before the title; bless an app-HUD capture.

warnings.title: Strain legend paints over the crisis banner when health is on and a crisis is active
warnings.det: Banner drops to y=58..~122 (x 420..870) when the meter is live; the legend line (y=76..90, x 12..~770) draws AFTER it, so during the surge the legend text crosses the banner's title/redesign rows. Visible live; no golden exercises health-on + active crisis.
warnings.fix: Anchor the legend below the banner when health is on (or right-align/stack), and add a capture with health on + crisis active.

warnings.title: Grace chips render an active countdown for HEALTHY classes (armed-full grace reads as a running countdown)
warnings.det: health_ensure arms grace_left FULL at first demand, and the chip condition reads only grace_left > 0 — so every demand-bearing class shows 'grace 20s' from tick 1, permanently, with zero breach. Confirmed in the blessed T2s (health_win 75s: both classes healthy, both chips show 'grace 20s'). A countdown must start on breach ENTER per the spec.
warnings.fix: Gate the countdown chip on breach[c] && grace_left > 0 (breach is live state the render already reads); keep the BREACHED chip for post-grace.

warnings.title: balance.json health block uses truncating/wrapping jint — crafted values silently wrap into valid ranges
warnings.det: jint does i64->i32 cast (wrap) + float truncate: 'window_ticks': 4294967496 wraps to 200 and passes 1..10000; decimals silently truncate. The block's own claim is fail-fast; packet_types health fields in the same story use rejecting jint_strict. Inconsistent + bypassable.
warnings.fix: Use jint_strict + an i64 range check before the cast (mirror the packet_types rows), and add wrapped-value reject rows to catalog_test.

warnings.title: No upper bound on drain_cap_pct_per_tick (or severity) — validation-legal data empties the meter in one tick (E16 'never instant' broken)
warnings.det: Validation requires only cap >= 1. A cap >= 100 makes the first post-grace drain tick pass meter_pct <= drain -> instant Run_Lost. Unbounded severity compounds it. Shipped data is fine (cap 2); the boundary claim isn't.
warnings.fix: Upper-bound the cap (e.g. <= 25) and severity (e.g. <= cap) with fail-fast rows; keeps E16 structural regardless of data.

warnings.title: `expect hash stable` directive is parsed but never enforced — dead guard over the blessed frozen tails
warnings.det: Both new demos declare `expect hash stable`; Demo.expect_hash_stable is written by parse_demo and read by nothing. A barrier regression followed by `harness save` would silently bless a non-frozen tail. The E17 freeze is currently pinned only by the blessed manifests + unit tests.
warnings.fix: Enforce it in run_demo (assert the post-terminal tail is identical) or drop the directive so the demos don't promise a check that doesn't exist.

warnings.title: E30 exit-band hysteresis unpinned; the 'band' assertion is a tautology
warnings.det: The exit-band check is `grace_left > 0 || grace_left == 0` — true for every u32, can never fail. No test pins that a ratio inside (27,30] keeps the latch (exit only at <= 27). Removing the exit margin would pass green.
warnings.fix: Assert the latch on a crafted windowed ratio in (exit, enter] stays breached, then exits at <= exit threshold.

warnings.title: E16 min-branch (severity below cap -> 1/tick drain) never rate-asserted
warnings.det: Every drain-rate assertion demands delta == 2 (max(1,2)=2, and the cap case). The email-alone drain at 1/tick (severity 1 < cap 2) executes in the fixture's post-grace band but is never asserted — max(severity) is only half-pinned.
warnings.fix: Step through the email-only post-grace band and assert delta == 1 before streaming joins the drain.

warnings.title: Surge-win gate negative branches (uptime < threshold, total == 0) never execute with the gate enabled
warnings.det: test_health_surge_win_below_threshold's run dies via the meter at ~255 (its own comment), so win_lose_eval's false branch + E24 total==0 guard never run with surge_done latched. A sub-90% live-meter survivor (e.g. future tolerant classes) is unpinned.
warnings.fix: Craft a below-threshold surge end with the meter alive (spread drops inside class tolerances) and assert no Run_Won; add a zero-completion surge-end case.

warnings.title: Health-on + active-crisis offset layout branch rendered in zero goldens
warnings.det: health_lose dies pre-surge (no crisis) and health_win is AC-E13-silent (no crisis) — the banner-y=68 branch (the exact branch where the legend/banner overlap lives) has no blessed frame; overlap regressions are invisible to the harness.
warnings.fix: Add a capture to health_lose.dem inside the surge window (crisis active + meter live), or a small dedicated demo, and bless it.

warnings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS (P0 100%, P1 ~83%)
warnings.det: P0 fully pinned (drain happy path, empty->Run_Lost E17, surge win at 3000, retry-clean, no-soft-lock property — 153 tests green). P1 gaps: same-tick collision (mechanism-only), below-cap drain rate, sub-threshold/zero-completion win branches, E30 exit band, recharge reject row.
warnings.fix: Close the P1 gaps above; the harness replay gate + drift-check (139 rejections) are already green.

warnings.title: balance.json health.win_uptime_pct is dead data — the win threshold is dual-sourced
warnings.det: win_uptime_pct is loaded, validated (1..100), and folded into catalog_hash (shifting every golden on tune) but read by NO sim/app/harness code — the real threshold is run-setup surge_win_pct (app const 90, demo file 90). Violates ODN-5 single-source; a tuner changing the balance knob sees nothing.
warnings.fix: Either consume the balance value as the default when run setup leaves surge_win_pct unset, or drop the knob from the block until it has a consumer.

notes.title: Frozen spec-artifact 'Boundaries' contradicts its own change log in 4 places (grace 200 vs 400; 15 vs 16 routers; byte-identical logs vs 8-byte re-bless; no-drops vs 489)
notes.det: The code implements the corrected values everywhere (change log, PR body, demos, PRB-verified re-bless). The artifact's frozen section should be amended to avoid misleading future rounds.
notes.fix: Amend the Boundaries section to match the change log.

notes.title: A severity-0 class (validation-legal) expires its grace but Grace_Expired is never emitted (drain==0 gate)
notes.det: Expiry emission lives inside the drain > 0 branch; with all drained classes at severity 0 the event is swallowed and the class never drains. Shipped severities are 1/2 — unreachable with current data.
notes.fix: Emit Grace_Expired from the expired list regardless of drain, or reject severity 0 at load.

notes.title: recharge_pct_per_tick == 0 (validation-legal) emits an unchanged Meter_Changed every healthy tick and the meter can never return to 100
notes.det: The recharge branch appends Meter_Changed even when the +0 leaves the value unchanged — no-op event spam; 'recharges when healthy' is configurable-off by data. Shipped value is 1.
notes.fix: Skip the event when recharge is 0 (or require >= 1 at load).

notes.title: Exit margin >= a class's tolerance clamps the exit threshold to 0 (stricter than the spec's band; margins validated only >= 0)
notes.det: With exit_loss 0 a class must reach literally zero loss/latency to exit. Shipped margins (3/40ms) are far under the tolerances — data-edge only.
notes.fix: Bound margins < tolerance at load, or document the clamp semantics.

notes.title: surge_done never resets when a new crisis set-piece activation starts (stale latch + reset accumulators could fire a mid-second-surge win)
notes.det: Demoted from warning: shipped data has exactly ONE one-shot surge activation (start 1200, duration 1800), so unreachable today. Latent when future eras re-activate crisis set-pieces.
notes.fix: Reset surge_done on a new activation (h.prev_in_surge rising edge), or freeze the accumulators per-activation.

notes.title: Health ring allocation = classes x window with an uncapped packet_types roster — crafted-data OOM foot-gun
notes.det: window is capped (10000) but the roster isn't (crises.json caps exist; packet_types never had one). 100k crafted classes x 10000 x 16B ~= 16GB. Shipped: 2 classes x 200. Pre-existing roster gap, newly amplified by the ring.
notes.fix: Cap the roster (u16 class-id bound) at load.

notes.title: health_update's `tick % window` has no runtime zero-guard — safety rests solely on catalogs_load validation
notes.det: A hand-built Catalogs (the established test convention) with the health block absent traps on division by zero. test_catalog sets window 200; catalogs_load enforces 1..10000 — today unreachable.
notes.fix: Guard `if win == 0 { return }` in health_update (cheap, makes the layer self-contained).

notes.title: Same-tick re-step zeroes the ring slot and permanently undercounts that tick's deltas in the rolling window (documented convention, no production re-step path)
notes.det: dd==0 on a re-step, so the slot's old delta is subtracted and never restored. The header documents this as accepted (app never re-steps, harness drains per step, replay never re-steps). No production path triggers it.
notes.fix: Optional: keep the previous slot value when dd==0 on a same-tick re-step (detect via state.tick).

notes.title: Test comment rot: fixture header (~260-tick breach) vs asserted ~5; drain-max comments (grace 50/10) vs actual (streaming 400/email 300); stale grace-200 bound comments
notes.det: Multiple timeline comments contradict each other and the fixture values. The assertions pass against the real numbers; the comments mislead the next reader.
notes.fix: Sweep the health_test comments to match the actual fixture constants.

notes.title: Serialization pin uses a byte-scan for `64 00 00 00` that could false-match any unrelated u32 == 100 (weak-but-honest pin)
notes.det: The pin would pass even if the health section were absent but some other field wrote 100. The comment admits the compromise. The golden-level re-bless fold provides the real regression signal.
notes.fix: Scan for the meter marker at the known section offset, or hash a sub-slice.

notes.title: The absent-when-disabled serialization contract is never unit-asserted (dump_off is deleted unchecked)
notes.det: Golden-level evidence exists (pre-4.3 .t1s shift ONLY via catalog_hash — Perkins-verified), but no unit assertion pins the rule itself.
notes.fix: Assert dump_off is byte-identical to a health-less baseline dump (or contains no meter/grace markers).

notes.title: recharge_pct_per_tick < 0 validation branch has no negative reject row
notes.det: Every other health-block validation branch has reject rows; the recharge >= 0 branch is unreached by any test.
notes.fix: Add a recharge-negative row to health_rows.

notes.title: check_ok never asserts the parsed health values (dropping the pt.health_* assignments would pass all catalog tests)
notes.det: The positive control resolves classes but doesn't assert health_grace_ticks / health_drain_pct_per_tick parsed values.
notes.fix: Assert the two fields on both entries in check_ok.

notes.title: health_win.dem header's ECMP-split figure (125 u/tick per router) contradicts its own numbers (1200/16 = 75)
notes.det: Comment math error; the headroom claim (160 vs 125) understates the actual margin (160 vs 75). The fixture works — the comment is wrong.
notes.fix: Fix the figure to 75 u/tick (or explain the 125).

notes.title: Game_Over win copy keys on the session flag, not which condition fired — a goal-win in a surge-configured session would mislabel
notes.det: Outcome carries no source; the branch reads surge_win_pct > 0. Unreachable in the shipped session (goal 0) — latent copy bug.
notes.fix: Key the copy on a win-source field (or on surge_done) instead of the config flag.

notes.title: The banner_y offset policy (10 + HEALTH_CARD_H + 6) is inlined in both app/main.odin and harness/goldens.odin
notes.det: The app HUD and the blessed captures must mirror the layout; two hand-maintained sites can drift silently (the harness wouldn't notice an app-only shift).
notes.fix: Expose one render-level helper (e.g. health_banner_y(health_on)) used by both call sites.

notes.title: Game_Over screen draw (win/lose copy + meter-on-gameover) has no automated coverage
notes.det: app/ has no tests and capture_frame never renders the Game_Over screen — the terminal presentation runs only in manual app play.
notes.fix: Extend capture_frame (or a small app-level smoke) to render the Game_Over state.

notes.title: parse_demo's new `win surge` / `health on` rejection branches are untested (no harness test suite exists)
notes.det: Malformed .dem inputs (pct > 100, non-'on' health verb) run only when authored. Happy paths are covered by both new demos.
notes.fix: Add harness parse tests, or fold rejections into a lint-time .dem validation.

notes.title: `win goal` parse truncates u64 -> u32 silently (carried 1.4 behavior; the new sibling `win surge` branch validates)
notes.det: `win goal 4294967296` parses then truncates to 0. Pre-existing, touched by this hunk's rewrite.
notes.fix: Reject goal > max(u32) like the surge branch rejects > 100.

notes.title: Recharge / grace-refill / hysteresis-exit recovery paths have zero golden coverage (unit-pinned only)
notes.det: The win demo never breaches and the lose demo drains to death — no blessed frame shows a recovering meter. Unit tests cover each path.
notes.fix: Optional: a third mini-demo capturing a breach-then-recover frame.

notes.title: GDD MVP lose row (uptime < 90% through the surge -> fail) has no dedicated terminal — below-threshold-without-breach continues the run
notes.det: Demoted from warning: with shipped tolerances a sub-90% window implies a streaming breach -> meter drain -> Run_Lost (the implementer's own test comment), so the gap is practically unreachable. Worth a designer's note for future tolerant classes.
notes.fix: Decide at playtest whether a below-threshold surge end should itself be terminal; document the choice.
